title: Nvidia Invests in Stargate Power Provider According to Reports
description: Reports indicate Nvidia plans a significant investment in Lancium, a power firm associated with the Stargate project.

sections.heading: Investment Plans
paragraphs: According to Межа. Новини України., Nvidia plans to invest up to $3 billion in Lancium for AI data centers. The Information reports that Nvidia is set to invest up to $3 billion in a power firm backed by Blackstone that is behind Stargate.

sections.heading: Role of Lancium
paragraphs: Blockonomi states that Nvidia is taking a $3 billion stake in Lancium, identifying it as the power provider for Stargate. The Information corroborates that the power firm involved is behind the Stargate project.

sections.heading: Search Trend Context
paragraphs: The term "stargate" is trending in the ES region. Google Trends data indicates a search lower bound of 500 for this keyword. The trend feed was published on August 8, 2026.

faq.q: What is the amount of Nvidia's planned investment?
faq.a: According to Межа. Новини України. and The Information, Nvidia plans to invest up to $3 billion.

faq.q: Who is the target of the investment?
faq.a: The investment is targeting Lancium, which Blockonomi identifies as the Stargate power provider.
